segments.ko: performsMultiPassEncodingIfSupported

segments.source: **Framework**: AVFoundation **Kind**: property
segments.ko: **Framework**: AVFoundation **Kind**: property

segments.source: A Boolean value that indicates whether the input attempts to encode the source media data using multiple passes.
segments.ko: 입력이 소스 미디어 데이터를 다단계로 인코딩하려고 시도하는지 나타내는 Boolean 값입니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.ko: iOS 8.0+

segments.source: iPadOS 8.0+
segments.ko: iPadOS 8.0+

segments.source: Mac Catalyst 13.1+
segments.ko: Mac Catalyst 13.1+

segments.source: macOS 10.10+
segments.ko: macOS 10.10+

segments.ko: tvOS 9.0+

segments.source: Declaration
segments.ko: Declaration

segments.source: Discussion
segments.ko: Discussion

segments.source: An asset writer input may be able to achieve higher quality and lower data rate by performing multiple passes over the source media.
segments.ko: The value is [`invalid`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreMedia/CMTime/invalid) while the effect is in progress, but changes to a valid time when the reaction effect completes and the system removes it from the list of [`reactionEffectsInProgress`](avcapturedevice/reactioneffectsinprogress.md).

segments.source: It does this by analyzing the media data it appends and reencodes certain segments with different parameters.
segments.ko: 이는 append한 미디어 데이터를 분석하고 특정 구간을 서로 다른 매개변수로 다시 인코딩함으로써 수행됩니다.

segments.source: To perform the reencoding, you must append the media data for the segments again.
segments.ko: 재인코딩을 수행하려면 해당 구간의 미디어 데이터를 다시 append해야 합니다.

segments.source: See the [`currentPassDescription`](avassetwriterinput/currentpassdescription.md) property and [`markCurrentPassAsFinished()`](avassetwriterinput/markcurrentpassasfinished().md) method for the means by which the input nominates segments to reappend.
segments.ko: 입력이 다시 append할 구간을 지정하는 방법은 [`currentPassDescription`](avassetwriterinput/currentpassdescription.md) property와 [`markCurrentPassAsFinished()`](avassetwriterinput/markcurrentpassasfinished().md) method를 참고합니다.

segments.source: When the value of this property is [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), the value of [`isReadyForMoreMediaData`](avassetwriterinput/isreadyformoremediadata.md) for other inputs attached to the same asset writer may be [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) more often and for longer periods of time.
segments.ko: 이 property의 값이 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)인 경우, 동일한 asset writer에 연결된 다른 입력의 [`isReadyForMoreMediaData`](avassetwriterinput/isreadyformoremediadata.md) 값이 더 자주 그리고 더 긴 시간 동안 [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false)일 수 있습니다.

segments.source: In particular, the value of [`isReadyForMoreMediaData`](avassetwriterinput/isreadyformoremediadata.md) for inputs that don’t perform multiple passes may start as [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) after calling the method asset writer’s [`startWriting()`](avassetwriter/startwriting().md) method, and may not change to [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) until after all multipass inputs complete their final pass.
segments.ko: 특히, 다중 패스를 수행하지 않는 입력의 [`isReadyForMoreMediaData`](avassetwriterinput/isreadyformoremediadata.md) 값은 asset writer의 [`startWriting()`](avassetwriter/startwriting().md) 메서드 호출 후 [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false)로 시작할 수 있으며, 모든 멀티패스 입력이 최종 pass를 완료한 뒤까지 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)로 변경되지 않을 수 있습니다.

segments.source: When the value of this property is [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), the input may store data in one or more temporary files before writing compressed samples to the output file.
segments.ko: 이 property의 값이 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)인 경우 입력은 압축 샘플을 출력 파일에 쓰기 전에 하나 이상의 임시 파일에 데이터를 저장할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Use the asset writer’s [`directoryForTemporaryFiles`](avassetwriter/directoryfortemporaryfiles.md) property if you need to specify the location of temporary file writing.
segments.ko: 임시 파일 쓰기 위치를 지정해야 하는 경우 자산 작성기의 [`directoryForTemporaryFiles`](avassetwriter/directoryfortemporaryfiles.md) property를 사용합니다.

segments.source: The default value is [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), which means that no additional analysis occurs and it doesn’t reencode segments.
segments.ko: 기본값은 [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false)이며, 이는 추가 분석이 수행되지 않고 구간을 다시 인코딩하지 않음을 의미합니다.

segments.source: Not all asset writer input configurations benefit from performing multiple passes over the source media.
segments.ko: 모든 자산 작성기 입력 구성에서 소스 미디어에 대해 다중 패스를 수행한다고 이점을 얻는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.source: To determine whether the selected encoder can perform multiple passes, query the value of [`canPerformMultiplePasses`](avassetwriterinput/canperformmultiplepasses.md) after calling [`startWriting()`](avassetwriter/startwriting().md).
segments.ko: 선택한 인코더가 다중 패스를 수행할 수 있는지 확인하려면 [`startWriting()`](avassetwriter/startwriting().md) 호출 후 [`canPerformMultiplePasses`](avassetwriterinput/canperformmultiplepasses.md) 값을 조회합니다.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: It’s an error to set this property value to [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) when the value for [`expectsMediaDataInRealTime`](avassetwriterinput/expectsmediadatainrealtime.md) is [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true).
segments.ko: ❗ **중요**: [`expectsMediaDataInRealTime`](avassetwriterinput/expectsmediadatainrealtime.md) 값이 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)일 때 이 property 값을 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)로 설정하면 오류입니다.

segments.source: It’s also an error for an asset writer to contain inputs with this property set to [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) when any of its other inputs have a value of [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) for [`expectsMediaDataInRealTime`](avassetwriterinput/expectsmediadatainrealtime.md).
segments.ko: 또한 asset writer에 포함된 다른 입력 중 하나라도 [`expectsMediaDataInRealTime`](avassetwriterinput/expectsmediadatainrealtime.md) 값이 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)일 때, 이 property가 [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true)로 설정된 입력이 포함되는 것도 오류입니다.
